description: This file defines the `Subscription` class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the admin model for handling sale subscriptions. It contains methods for managing subscription records, such as creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving subscription data, histories, logs, and related products.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents subscription management functionalities in the Opencart admin sale module. Handles CRUD operations, histories, logs, options, and related subscription data.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record by its ID, along with related products, histories, and logs.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining quantity for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Sets the next date for the subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes subscriptions associated with a specific customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record by its ID, decoding payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by associated order and product IDs, decoding methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches multiple subscription records based on filter criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Counts total subscription records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions for a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions with a specific status.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes associated subscription products for a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for a subscription's specific product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes options for a given subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history record for a subscription and updates its status.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history records for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts histories filtered by subscription status.

methods.name: deleteLogs
methods.description: Deletes log records associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves log records for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Counts total log records for a subscription.
